title: 3dTcorrMap
description: AFNI program to compute correlation maps of input time series data

input.description: Read 3D+time dataset 'dd'. This provides the time series to be correlated en masse. This is a mandatory option.
input.title: Input dataset

seed.description: Read 3D+time dataset 'bb'. It correlates the -seed voxel time series with every voxel in the -input dataset.
seed.title: Seed dataset

mask.description: Read dataset 'mmm' as a voxel mask.
mask.title: Mask dataset

automask.description: Create a mask from the input dataset.
automask.title: Automask

mean.description: Save average correlations into dataset prefix 'pp'.
mean.title: Mean correlations output prefix

zmean.description: Save tanh of mean arctanh(correlation) into 'pp'.
zmean.title: Tanh of mean arctanh output prefix

pmean.description: Save average of squared positive correlations into 'pp'.
pmean.title: Positive squared correlation output prefix

thresh.description: Save the COUNT of how many voxels survived thresholding at level abs(correlation) >= tt.
thresh.title: Thresholding level

varthresh.description: Save the COUNT of how many voxels survive thresholding at multiple levels abs(correlation) >= tt.
varthresh.title: Variable thresholding levels

norm_varthresh.description: Like '-VarThresh', but the output counts are 'Normalized'.
norm_varthresh.title: Normalized variable thresholding levels

corrmap.description: Output at each voxel the entire correlation map, into a dataset with prefix 'pp'.
corrmap.title: Correlation map output prefix

corrmask.description: By default, -CorrMap outputs a sub-brick for EACH input dataset voxel. Eliminates these sub-bricks using this option.
corrmask.title: Correlation mask

aexpr.description: For each correlation 'r', compute the calc-style expression 'expr', and average these values to get the output that goes into dataset 'ppp'.
aexpr.title: Average expression

cexpr.description: As in '-Aexpr', but only average together nonzero values computed by 'expr'.
cexpr.title: Conditional average expression

sexpr.description: As above, but the sum of the expressions is computed rather than the average.
sexpr.title: Sum expression

hist.description: For each voxel, save a histogram of the correlation coefficients into dataset ppp.
hist.title: Correlation coefficient histogram
